abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate testicular microlithiasis (TM) prospectively with modern state-of-the-art equipment. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Information concerning indication for examination, presence and degree of TM, presence of testicular tumor, and patient age was prospectively recorded for all patients referred for scrotal ultrasonography between 1996 and 1999. High-frequency linear transducers (7.5 MHz or higher) were used. TM was divided into classic (CTM) and limited (LTM) on the basis of the presence of five or more microliths on one or more images of the testes. Fisher exact tests were used for determining significant differences in proportions. RESULTS: Data in 1,079 patients were analyzed. The overall prevalence of TM was 18.1% (195 of 1,079). Forty (3.7%) patients had CTM, and 155 (14.4%) had LTM; 15 (1.4%) had tumors visible at US. Tumors were present in three (8%) of 40 patients with CTM (seminoma in two, embryonal cell in one), nine (5.8%) of 155 with LTM (seminoma in six, mixed germ cell in one, Leydig cell in two), and three (0.3%) of 884 with no TM (seminoma in two, other in one). There was no difference between CTM and LTM (P =.72) in the rate of coexisting tumor. There was a significant difference between no TM and CTM or LTM (P </=.001) in the rate of coexisting tumor. Eighty percent (12 of 15) of patients with tumor at presentation had CTM or LTM. CONCLUSION: Approximately one of 27 patients had CTM, and one of seven had LTM. Although a majority of patients with testicular tumors had coexistent TM, more than 90% with TM (both CTM and LTM) did not have tumor at presentation.
abstract_ja:
目的：最新の高性能機器を用いて精巣微小石灰化(TM)を前向きに評価すること。
材料と方法：1996年から1999年の間に陰嚢超音波検査を依頼されたすべての患者について、検査の適応、TMの有無と程度、精巣腫瘍の有無、患者の年齢に関する情報を前向きに記録した。7.5MHz以上の高周波リニアトランスデューサを使用した。TMは、精巣の画像上で1枚以上に5個以上の微小石灰化が認められる場合を古典型(CTM)と限局型(LTM)に分類した。割合の有意差の検定にはFisher正確検定を用いた。
結果：1,079例を解析した。TMの全体の有病率は18.1%(1,079例中195例)であった。CTMは40例(3.7%)、LTMは155例(14.4%)にみられた。超音波検査で腫瘍が視認できたのは15例(1.4%)であった。CTMの40例中3例(8%)に腫瘍を認め(セミノーマ2例、胎児性癌1例)、LTMの155例中9例(5.8%)に腫瘍を認めた(セミノーマ6例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍1例、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍2例)。TMのない884例中3例(0.3%)に腫瘍を認めた(セミノーマ2例、その他1例)。合併腫瘍の割合は、CTMとLTMの間に差はなかった(P=.72)。TMなしとCTMまたはLTMの間では、合併腫瘍の割合に有意差があった(P≤.001)。初診時に腫瘍を認めた患者の80%(15例中12例)はCTMまたはLTMを有していた。
結論：約27例に1例がCTM、約7例に1例がLTMであった。精巣腫瘍患者の大多数に合併してTMがみられたが、TM(CTMおよびLTMの両方)を有する患者の90%超は初診時に腫瘍を認めなかった。
